source_failure_path.fact: The actual server and first/replayed push success assertions precede line 1590. The failing assertion follows authenticated sync with --auth-secret, --server-public and --session-generation.
priced_sync_context returns true if any of those authentication options is present. The sync branch calls sync_host_kernel_owner(address, priced_sync_context(&args)) before importing history.
The priced branch calls require_host_kernel_budget with Some(FIXED_PUBLIC_KERNEL_PARENT), even for a loopback peer.

KernelBudget::open canonicalizes /sys/fs/cgroup/trnmponpublic.slice. An I/O error there is mapped to PUBLIC_HOST_KERNEL_PARENT before membership, resource limits or current process-identity comparisons.

A local caller outside the actual original host does not acquire host authority. Unless both GITHUB_ACTIONS and CI are true, the helper returns false and lets the original test execute, including its original refusal. True CI delegates the exact current ELF and CLI to the source-bound fixture runner.
